import argparse
import cv2
from some_ppocr_lib import (
    build_option,
    set_dynamic_option,
    set_model_path,
    set_parameters,
    read_model,
    preprocessor,
    postprocessor,
    PPStructureV2Table,
    vis_detection,
)

def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="PPOCR StructureV2 Table Inference")
    parser.add_argument('--det_model_path', type=str, required=True, help='Path to detection model')
    parser.add_argument('--rec_model_path', type=str, required=True, help='Path to recognition model')
    parser.add_argument('--table_model_path', type=str, required=True, help='Path to table recognition model')
    parser.add_argument('--rec_label_file', type=str, required=True, help='Path to recognition model label file')
    parser.add_argument('--table_dict_path', type=str, required=True, help='Path to table recognition dictionary')
    parser.add_argument('--rec_batch_num', type=int, default=6, help='Recognition model inference batch size')
    parser.add_argument('--image_path', type=str, required=True, help='Test image file path')
    parser.add_argument('--device', type=str, default='cpu', choices=['cpu', 'gpu', 'xpu', 'ascend'], help='Inference device type')
    parser.add_argument('--device_id', type=int, default=0, help='Device ID')
    parser.add_argument('--backend', type=str, default='onnxruntime', choices=['onnxruntime', 'paddle', 'tensorrt', 'openvino', 'paddle_lite'], help='Inference backend type')
    return parser.parse_args()

def build_runtime_option(model_path, device, device_id, backend, trt_cache_path=None):
    option = build_option()
    set_model_path(option, model_path)
    if backend == 'onnxruntime':
        option.use_onnxruntime()
        if device == 'cpu':
            option.use_cpu()
        elif device == 'gpu':
            option.use_gpu(device_id)
    elif backend == 'paddle':
        option.use_paddle_infer()
        if device == 'cpu':
            option.use_cpu()
        elif device == 'gpu':
            option.use_gpu(device_id)
    elif backend == 'tensorrt':
        option.use_trt_backend()
        option.use_gpu(device_id)
        set_dynamic_option(option, min_shape=[1,3,32,32], opt_shape=[1,3,640,640], max_shape=[1,3,1280,1280])
        if trt_cache_path:
            option.set_trt_cache_file(trt_cache_path)
    elif backend == 'openvino':
        option.use_openvino()
        option.use_cpu()
    elif backend == 'paddle_lite':
        option.use_lite_backend()
        if device == 'cpu':
            option.use_cpu()
        elif device == 'gpu':
            option.use_gpu(device_id)
    elif backend == 'ascend':
        option.use_ascend()
        option.use_ascend_device(device_id)
    return option

def main():
    args = parse_args()

    det_trt_cache = "det_trt_cache.trt"
    rec_trt_cache = "rec_trt_cache.trt"
    table_trt_cache = "table_trt_cache.trt"

    det_option = build_runtime_option(
        args.det_model_path, args.device, args.device_id, args.backend,
        trt_cache_path=det_trt_cache if args.backend == 'tensorrt' else None
    )
    rec_option = build_runtime_option(
        args.rec_model_path, args.device, args.device_id, args.backend,
        trt_cache_path=rec_trt_cache if args.backend == 'tensorrt' else None
    )
    table_option = build_runtime_option(
        args.table_model_path, args.device, args.device_id, args.backend,
        trt_cache_path=table_trt_cache if args.backend == 'tensorrt' else None
    )

    det_model = read_model(det_option)
    rec_model = read_model(rec_option)
    table_model = read_model(table_option)

    det_preproc = preprocessor(det_model)
    det_postproc = postprocessor(det_model)
    det_postproc.set_parameters(box_thresh=0.5, unclip_ratio=1.5, max_candidates=1000)

    structure = PPStructureV2Table(
        det_model=det_model,
        rec_model=rec_model,
        table_model=table_model,
        rec_label_file=args.rec_label_file,
        table_dict_path=args.table_dict_path
    )
    structure.rec_batch_num = args.rec_batch_num

    image = cv2.imread(args.image_path)
    results = structure.predict(image)
    print(results)

    vis_img = vis_detection(image, results)
    save_path = args.image_path + ".vis.jpg"
    cv2.imwrite(save_path, vis_img)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
